actions.action_text: Move 40 cases of Bottled water from Hub North to Pantry 12, ship on Nov 6, arrives Nov 7.
actions.why_text: Pantry 12 runs out on Nov 8 (projected unmet 55 cases over 3 days); Hub North has 120 cases beyond its protected need; 30 of them expire Nov 12.

non_additive_label: effect of this action given the rest of the plan; effects don't add up across actions
